svg.title: The same swipe now moves the table, not the page
svg.desc: Four phone screenshots of /features at 390px. Before the change a sideways swipe pans the whole 670px-wide page, carrying the tabs, filter and header off screen. After it, the page stays at 390px and only the table scrolls inside its region.
svg.text: The same swipe now moves the table, not the page
/features on a 390px touch screen, before and after one sideways swipe

g.text: The page is 670px wide, so the swipe
pans all of it: tabs and filter slide off.
The page stays 390px wide; the swipe
scrolls only the table, 292px, in place.
